istem:
Research question: 6G kablosuz ağ yönetiminde (kaynak tahsisi, yörünge tasarımı, optimizasyon) büyük dil modellerinin kullanımı üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?

Cutoff date: 2025-08-07. Only works published BEFORE this date count.

List the 30 most important works (papers) for this research question that were published before the cutoff date, in order of importance (most important first) — the kind a careful expert survey published right after the cutoff would cite. Give each with its arXiv id and/or DOI.

You MUST research this with web search rather than answer from memory: search for the important works, and verify each listed work's title, publication date and identifier on the web (e.g. arxiv.org, doi.org, the publisher or DBLP page) before including it.

When you are done, reply with ONLY a JSON object in this form (no other text):
{"calismalar": [{"sira": 1, "baslik": "exact title", "yil": 2020, "arxiv_id": "arXiv id or null", "doi": "DOI or null", "gerekce": "one sentence on why this work is important"}]}
with exactly 30 items. If you do not know an identifier, use null instead of guessing.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Model (LLM) for Telecommunications: A Comprehensive Survey on Principles, Key Techniques, and Opportunities
calismalar.gerekce: This is the main telecom-focused LLM survey: it sorts LLM uses into generation, classification, optimization and prediction tasks and lays out the open challenges.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Model (LLM)-enabled In-context Learning for Wireless Network Optimization: A Case Study of Power Control
calismalar.gerekce: It shows that an LLM can serve as a training-free optimizer for base-station power control through in-context learning, coming close to what deep reinforcement learning achieves.

calismalar.baslik: LLM-OptiRA: LLM-Driven Optimization of Resource Allocation for Non-Convex Problems in Wireless Communications
calismalar.gerekce: It is the first framework in which an LLM automatically finds the non-convex parts of a wireless resource allocation problem and rewrites them into solvable form.

calismalar.baslik: Generative AI Agents With Large Language Model for Satellite Networks via a Mixture of Experts Transmission
calismalar.gerekce: It uses an LLM with retrieval-augmented generation to formulate the optimization model for satellite networks, then solves it with MoE-PPO.

calismalar.baslik: WirelessLLM: Empowering Large Language Models Towards Wireless Intelligence
calismalar.gerekce: It sets out knowledge alignment, fusion and evolution as the guiding principles for adapting LLMs to wireless systems.

calismalar.baslik: WirelessAgent: Large Language Model Agents for Intelligent Wireless Networks
calismalar.gerekce: It presents an LLM agent architecture with perception, memory, planning and action modules, and tests it on network-slicing resource allocation.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Models for Networking: Applications, Enabling Techniques, and Challenges
calismalar.gerekce: This is an early framework paper on LLMs for network planning and management; its ChatNet system pairs a network-adapted LLM with external network tools.

calismalar.baslik: Large Multi-Modal Models (LMMs) as Universal Foundation Models for AI-Native Wireless Systems
calismalar.gerekce: It sets out the vision for wireless-specific multimodal foundation models built on grounding, causal reasoning and instructibility.

calismalar.baslik: TeleQnA: A Benchmark Dataset to Assess Large Language Models Telecommunications Knowledge
calismalar.gerekce: It is the first widely used benchmark for measuring how much telecom knowledge LLMs have.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Models as Optimizers
calismalar.gerekce: Its OPRO method founded the LLM-as-optimizer approach that the wireless optimization papers build on.

calismalar.baslik: OptiMUS: Scalable Optimization Modeling with (MI)LP Solvers and Large Language Models
calismalar.gerekce: It is the reference method for automatically turning natural-language problems into MILP models and solver code, and wireless work uses it as a baseline.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Model Based Multi-Objective Optimization for Integrated Sensing and Communications in UAV Networks
calismalar.gerekce: It optimizes UAV placement and power control by using an LLM as the search operator inside a multi-objective evolutionary algorithm.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Model (LLM)-enabled Graphs in Dynamic Networking
calismalar.gerekce: It has an LLM generate the UAV trajectory and a graph neural network handle resource allocation, an early example of a hybrid LLM-based trajectory design.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Model as a Catalyst: A Paradigm Shift in Base Station Siting Optimization
calismalar.gerekce: It applies prompt optimization and single- and multi-agent LLM setups to base-station siting, tested on real-world data.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Model Enhanced Multi-Agent Systems for 6G Communications
calismalar.gerekce: It proposes a multi-agent LLM system for 6G communication tasks built on retrieval, planning, and evaluation with reflection.

calismalar.baslik: When Large Language Model Agents Meet 6G Networks: Perception, Grounding, and Alignment
calismalar.gerekce: It describes an architecture that splits LLM agents between mobile devices and the edge in 6G networks, along with a model-caching algorithm.

calismalar.baslik: Pushing Large Language Models to the 6G Edge: Vision, Challenges, and Opportunities
calismalar.gerekce: It sets out the vision and open problems for training and running LLMs at the 6G edge.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Models for Telecom: Forthcoming Impact on the Industry
calismalar.gerekce: It identifies the near-term telecom use cases for LLMs and the research challenges they raise.

calismalar.baslik: Large Generative AI Models for Telecom: The Next Big Thing?
calismalar.gerekce: It is among the first visionary papers on the role of large generative models in AI-native 6G networks.

calismalar.baslik: Interactive AI with Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Next Generation Networking
calismalar.gerekce: It shows a network management and optimization framework in which an LLM with retrieval-augmented generation designs the optimization problem itself.

calismalar.baslik: NetLLM: Adapting Large Language Models for Networking
calismalar.gerekce: It is a general framework for adapting pre-trained LLMs to networking decision tasks such as adaptive bitrate streaming and job scheduling.

calismalar.baslik: LLM4CP: Adapting Large Language Models for Channel Prediction
calismalar.gerekce: It shows that adapted LLMs work at the physical layer, using them to predict channels in massive MIMO systems.

calismalar.baslik: GenAINet: Enabling Wireless Collective Intelligence via Knowledge Transfer and Reasoning
calismalar.gerekce: Its distributed LLM agents share knowledge and reason together, demonstrated on power control.

calismalar.baslik: TelecomGPT: A Framework to Build Telecom-Specfic Large Language Models
calismalar.gerekce: It gives a pipeline for building a telecom-specific LLM and introduces a Telecom Math Modeling benchmark.

calismalar.baslik: Hermes: A Large Language Model Framework on the Journey to Autonomous Networks
calismalar.gerekce: It chains LLM agents to build network digital twin instances automatically, a step toward autonomous network management.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Models Empowered Autonomous Edge AI for Connected Intelligence
calismalar.gerekce: It is an early demonstration of a GPT-based LLM coordinating edge AI models and planning tasks.

calismalar.baslik: ReEvo: Large Language Models as Hyper-Heuristics with Reflective Evolution
calismalar.gerekce: It is the core method for having LLMs generate heuristics for combinatorial optimization, and wireless optimization work cites it as a baseline.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Models (LLMs) for Wireless Networks: An Overview from the Prompt Engineering Perspective
calismalar.gerekce: It surveys prompt-engineering methods for training-free wireless network optimization.

calismalar.baslik: Prompting Wireless Networks: Reinforced In-Context Learning for Power Control
calismalar.gerekce: It improves the selection of in-context examples with reinforcement learning, so that the LLM optimizer outperforms RL-based methods.

calismalar.baslik: Mixture of Experts for Network Optimization: A Large Language Model-enabled Approach
calismalar.gerekce: It uses an LLM to interpret user requests and choose among pre-trained DRL expert models for network optimization; it won best paper at IWCMC 2024.
